INSERT INTO sys_workspace_invitation
id, workspace_id, email, role_id, invited_by, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at,
#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{email}, #{roleId}, #{invitedBy}, #{token}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{acceptedAt}, now(), now(),
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, u.nickname AS invitedByName FROM sys_workspace_invitation i LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON i.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON i.invited_by = u.id WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND i.status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT i.*, w.name AS workspaceName, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, u.nickname AS inviterName FROM sys_workspace_invitation i LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON i.workspace_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON i.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON i.invited_by = u.id WHERE i.token = #{token}

SELECT i.*, w.name AS workspaceName, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, u.nickname AS inviterName FROM sys_workspace_invitation i LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON i.workspace_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON i.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON i.invited_by = u.id WHERE LOWER(i.email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND i.status = 0 AND i.expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
